args.subject: Group Booking Availability Request – 10 Guests in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I found your group bookings address through a guest review of City Hub Tokyo and am writing to enquire about availability for a group stay.

We would like to book for 10 people in June 2024. Could you please let me know:

- Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June 2024
- The available dates and any minimum-stay requirements
- Group rates or discounts, and whether any group amenities (such as a shared breakfast space or meeting area) are included
- The best way to proceed with the reservation

Our preferred dates are flexible at this stage, so please share whatever options you have available.

For reference, my contact details are:
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923

Thank you for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
